items.source: If this method returns false, then the underlying class is a top-level class.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回false，则底层类是一个顶层类。

items.source: Return the name of the enclosing class of the underlying class, or null if the underlying class is a top-level class.
items.translation: 返回底层类的封装类名称，如果底层类是顶层类，则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return the name of the superclass of the underlying class, or null if there is no superclass defined.
items.translation: 返回底层类的超类名称，如果未定义超类则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return the name of the underlying class.

Return the names of all interfaces that the underlying class
implements, or an empty array if there are none.
items.translation: 返回底层类实现的所有接口的名称，如果没有则返回空数组。

items.source: Return whether the underlying class has a superclass.
items.translation: 返回底层类是否有父类。

items.source: Return whether the underlying class is marked as abstract.
items.translation: 返回底层类是否被标记为抽象。

items.source: Return whether the underlying class represents an annotation.
items.translation: 返回底层类是否表示注解。

items.source: Return whether the underlying class is marked as 'final'.
items.translation: 返回底层类是否标记为 'final'。

items.source: Return whether the underlying class represents an interface.
items.translation: 返回底层类是否表示接口。

items.source:
Return whether the underlying class represents a concrete class,
i.e. neither an interface nor an abstract class.
items.translation: 返回底层类是否表示具体类，即既不是接口也不是抽象类。

items.source:
Determine whether the underlying class is independent, i.e. whether it is
a top-level class or a static nested class that can be constructed
independently of an enclosing class.
items.translation: 确定底层类是否独立，即它是否为顶层类或可独立于外部类构造的静态嵌套类。

items.source:
Return the names of all classes declared as members of the class represented by
this ClassMetadata object. This includes public, protected, default (package)
access, and private classes and interfaces declared by the class, but excludes
inherited classes and interfaces. An empty array is returned if no member classes
or interfaces exist.
items.translation: 返回此 `ClassMetadata` 对象所表示的类中声明的所有类的名称。这包括该类声明的具有 public、protected、默认（包）访问权限和 private 访问权限的类和接口，但不包括继承的类和接口。如果不存在成员类或接口，则返回一个空数组。

items.source:
Interface that defines abstract metadata of a specific class,
in a form that does not require that class to be loaded yet.
items.translation: 定义特定类抽象元数据的接口，其形式无需先加载该类。

items.source:
Return the names of all classes declared as members of the class represented by
this ClassMetadata object.
items.translation: 返回此 ClassMetadata 对象所表示的类中声明的所有成员类的名称。
